reviews.body: Encantada con la compra. Llegó antes de lo previsto. La puerta lateral de mi coche no se abre del todo, y esta escalera se adapta a la perfección. Muy fácil de desplegar/plegar y ligero. Mi perra, una mezcla entre setter y border collie tiene + de 12 años, no sube fon tanta agilidad como antes, y esta escalera le facilita mucho la vida. A quien tenga dudas (quiza por el precio) personalmente lo recomiendo 100%, es una inversión que merece la pena.

reviews.title: Easy, attractive and works like a charm
reviews.body:
I have a 44 lb 8 mo old lab. A sweet little fireball named River.
I also have Lexus RX 350 SUV. Similar to the promo picture here on Amazon.
I tried another product first which as a foldable ramp. Very steep and my dog was "no ... way I am going down that thing"...despite his willingness to jump on a AC unit and vaulting over a fence a few weeks ago. Another issue with the ramp is that it extends into the street..when trying the side door. Also, it would not fit in my side door well. (But the quality of that product was very good if it is right for your dog and situation.)
I then found this product. Bit pricey. But the best option from my choices.
Turned out to be ideal. Get what you pay for.
Lightweight. Very good quality. Looks sharp. Folds very compact easily. Nice foot pads to prevent slipping. Perfect size for my car height. Adjustable. Multiple various options with it. Well thought out and built. No brainer.
River was somewhat willing to do it with a push.
So I chopped up some steak pieces. Within 2 or 3 pieces of steak up and down he was hauling up and down those steps, often without prompting. Was fairly easy to get him to do it after that.
Day 2 of training with more steak. He would take a step or two and fly the rest of the way.
Worth its weight in gold.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 23 de mayo de 2025

reviews.title: Compact & Convenient to use
reviews.body: My dog is 11 and a half and he recently hurt both legs on his right side (within a few weeks of each other) his recovery has been extremely slow so I've been having to lift him in and out of the car. I've been a struggling with this because he weighs 22kg so I started looking at the ramps and stair options available. In the end I decided the stairs seemed the better option so I purchased the Vevor dog stairs and I've been really happy with the quality and how easy they are to use. My dog was a bit reluctant to use them initially but it only took a few minutes before he got the hang of it and now he happily goes up and down. The stairs are lightweight and compact which makes them even more convenient. I highly recommend these if you have a dog that needs help getting in and out of the car.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Australia el 9 de octubre de 2025

reviews.title: Light and easy to use. Dog uses no problem
reviews.body: These are great, my lab collie cross around 27kg has got arthritis now he is much older. He stopped being able to jump in the boot. He was a bit unsure first of all, but a bit of ham tempted him up the steps and now he is using them no problem. Very stable and not heavy so easy for me to use. Folded us in second easily.
